children: WEX entered into an amendment to its credit agreement to refinance approximately $1.2 billion of existing term loans with new loans in substantially the same amount. The new loans mature on November 24, 2033, and carry interest at SOFR plus 0.75% or, for base-rate borrowings, the base rate plus 1.75%. The refinancing extends the maturity of this debt.
